g.text: Multi-Tenant Architecture, Module Entitlements, Scoped Roles & Operational Workflows
Subdomain Scope • Manages Selected Subscribed Modules
Prosthesis specs, shade, teeth matrix, due dates
Try-in approval gates & doctor review alerts
Courier dispatch voucher & lab fee billing
Patient Care, Dental Charting & Practice Operations
Multi-doctor calendar, chair scheduling, email notifications
Visual tooth conditions, periodontal pocket records
Procedure sequencing, medication Rx, lab orders
Clinic Doctor dispatches custom lab orders directly from patient chart ➔ Lab manufactures prosthesis through QC gates ➔ Status updates reflect live in Clinic EHR
Loose coupling maintained via domain events & application contracts (no direct DB foreign key locks)
